## Activity

Central Eye Clinic recorded 125 captures during February 2022. This represents the activity reported for the month and provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures below. The recorded capture volume should continue to be monitored through routine site operations reporting. Any operational matters affecting capture activity should be documented and raised through the appropriate local process.

## Image quality

Of the 125 captures, 1 was ungradable. The ungradable rate was 0.8 per cent. The clinic should continue to support consistent image acquisition and ensure that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. Clear records of equipment concerns will help maintain visibility of any issues affecting image quality.

## Grading

There were 28 referable results during February 2022. The median grading lag was 16 days. These results should be considered alongside the reported capture volume and image quality measures when reviewing site performance. Routine reporting should continue to identify any changes in referable results or grading timeliness and to support follow-up of operational issues.
